location: line 301, thm:simplicity:validation(i): 'choosing $c$ by held-out log-loss picks, with probability tending to one as $N\to\infty$, a grid value whose selected hypothesis has least risk; the smallest grid value always qualifies'
problem: The claim needs a unique population minimizer at each grid value; the round-2 re-verifier said the result is 'essentially correct when each grid c has a unique population minimizer'. Lemma empirical only recovers a unique minimizer with a gap. With ties, the empirical choice at a grid value can alternate between co-minimizers of different risk. The hypothesis is still missing.
